evidenceBoundary.generation2Source: G2-07 Practical Comeback / Reply-Pressure Representation Study 1

rootSource.desiredPhaseBySeedParity: odd seed -> namua; even seed -> mtaji
rootSource.rootSelectionWithinTrajectory: minimum SHA-256 rank over candidateVersion, desired phase, seed, ply and strict RAW key

eligibleSelection.eligibility: frozen baseline hard/enhanced/bao D3 completes without timeout and its actual enhanced-search execution visits at least one depth-zero ply-3 cutoff state that is nonterminal, opponent-to-root-player, and has exact legal move variant count == 1
eligibleSelection.selectionWhenMoreThanTarget: minimum SHA-256 rank over candidateVersion, phase, seed, ply, strict RAW key, single-reply occurrence count and unique single-reply cutoff digest

strictRawIdentity.serialization: stable JSON object with exactly the frozen fields in listed order

baselineSearch.measurementMethod: observation-only VM instrumentation of the byte-identical frozen baseline public/ai.js; observer is invoked after terminal check and immediately before baseline depth-zero quiescence return; no candidate extension is executed

singleReplyCutoff.counting: every actual enhanced-search depth-zero ply-3 occurrence is counted; unique cutoff RAW states are additionally deduplicated by strict RAW SHA-256

measurements.trajectoryRootsAvailable: number of frozen trajectories contributing one consequence-blind source root
measurements.technicalFailures: source roots where baseline D3 does not complete exactly, times out, returns no move, observer violates actor/depth invariants, or observation-only instrumentation changes baseline selected move or pre-existing stats
measurements.eligibleRoots: valid source roots with at least one observed exact single-reply cutoff occurrence
measurements.singleReplyCutoffOccurrences: total observed eligible cutoff occurrences across valid source roots
measurements.selectedEligibleRoots: up to 128 eligible roots retained as canonical support examples under frozen hash ranking
